<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Independent Peritheos staged refit of digitized Fei (2007) NaCl-B2 study markers: 12 Figure 3 rows at 300 K determine K0/K0-prime with V0 fixed; then all 12 Figure 4 rows at 1000 K determine q with the cold fit frozen. The printed variable-exponent Debye law, V0, gamma0 and theta0 are inherited from the published record. Equal pressure weights are an analyst choice. Duplicate Figure 4 cold markers, other-paper comparisons and calculated curve vertices are excluded. This is a conditional figure-data refit, not reproduction of the authors' fit or independent validation of pressure accuracy. Original unrounded measurements, P/V/T errors, measured Pt cells, source weights and calibration covariance remain unavailable. Conditional stage errors are archived in fit statistics only; catalog parameter errors and covariance are unset because predictor, calibrant, fixed-anchor and inter-stage uncertainty are not propagated. Coverage consists of separate 300 and 1000 K series, not a validated P-T rectangle.
- **Reference isotherm:**
    - **V0:** Table 1 footnote: adopted from Bukowinski and Aidun (1985), fixed.
    - **K0:** Independent unweighted pressure-residual fit of 12 Figure 3 study markers at 300 K, with V0 fixed; see fit\_provenance.
    - **K0 prime:** Same independent cold fit as K0; neither coefficient replaces the published Fei record.
- **Thermal correction:**
    - **Tr:** Equation 3 subtracts Debye energy at 300 K.
    - **Theta0:** Table 1 footnote: 290 K adopted from Bukowinski and Aidun (1985). theta\_D=theta0\*(V/V0)^(-gamma(V)) is printed explicitly.
    - **Gamma0:** Table 1 footnote: 1.70 adopted from Bukowinski and Aidun (1985).
    - **Q:** Independent unweighted pressure-residual fit of all 12 Figure 4 hot markers at 1000 K, freezing the preceding cold fit and adopted gamma0/theta0; see fit\_provenance.
    - **N:** Two atoms per NaCl formula unit; V0=41.35 A^3 is a one-formula-unit B2 cell.

</details>
